articles.hed: NFL Desk: Dart Extended Absence; Bears QB Depth Shaky
articles.deck: Sources: Giants QB Jaxson Dart could miss the rest of the season after MNF knee; Chicago may lean on Case Keenum vs. Eagles if Williams and Bagent stay out.
articles.body: Tuesday tests flipped Monday Night’s optimistic tone: Jaxson Dart’s left knee is worse than first believed and he faces an extended absence with season-ending surgery on the table, sources told NFL Network. Jameis Winston is the bridge for Giants Week 3 vs. Titans. In Chicago, Caleb Williams remains week-to-week with a hamstring and backup Tyson Bagent entered concussion protocol — leaving Case Keenum as a possible starter for Monday’s Eagles game. Week 3 opens Thu with Falcons at Packers. Carry competitive calm into the midweek charge — then skim the board.

articles.hed: AI Desk: Sol, Luna & Opus 5.5 Hit the Price War
articles.deck: OpenAI and Anthropic shipped cheaper models within hours on Tue Sep 22; SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 still anchors the coding/knowledge lane at $2/$6.
articles.body: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 as a cheaper near-flagship (matching Fable on most tasks at a lower sticker), and OpenAI answered with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna — faster, cheaper cuts of Astra. The launches land days after CEOs publicly urged a slowdown, underscoring the tension between safety talk and competitive shipping. SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 (Sep 21) stays the value coding/knowledge play. Apple’s Siri AI beta on iOS 27 continues its waitlist rollout toward October language expansion. Full desks below.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Wednesday’s gate is cool cloudy radar and a clean midweek forge — not the scoreboard, not the admin stack. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Then own the middle of the week from the first breath.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not wait for perfect radar or a clean QB report to start. Fierce calm is Wednesday composure when the week already spent its noise: charge first, body second, security skim when ready, admin only after the morning has already won. One breath, one move, one clear next step. Competitors may still be replaying Dart’s timeline or the overnight model drops; he arrives prepared for the forge. When pressure rises, he slows the breath, names the next action, and outlasts the noise. Today is not about proving anything on the scoreboard. It is about banking competitive calm so Thursday’s Vegas gate and the rest of the board have a clean operator behind them. Fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Wednesday: run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Cool cloudy outside; tempo inside to open the midweek forge. Then news and the day.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time. Optional: Front Clips / Back Clips if you want a second RipStick move.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.hed: Iron Sharpens Iron on the Midweek Forge
grimoire.body: “Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another.” (Proverbs 27:17) Solomon’s counsel for a Wednesday morning is friction with purpose — contact that improves the edge, not contact that dulls it. Morning Charge and the 3-minute opener are the deliberate strike; a clean security skim is the careful grind; Later / Admin is the polish only after the blade already holds an edge. Classical lore cast Solomon as one who staged craftsmen before the temple rose. Stage the midweek the same way, so Thursday’s Vegas gate and the rest of the board meet a sharpened operator — not a scattered one.
grimoire.practice: Finish Opening Bell and the 3-minute opener before any security skim, injury-wire replay, or admin. Sharpen first; polish later.

techDemo.title: Tech Demo
techDemo.kicker: Fast learn · from your X bookmarks
techDemo.pick: Build a full app with Claude in 26 live minutes
techDemo.author: @AnatoliKopadze

image.alt: Newsprint diagram — 26-Minute Claude App Build: Scope → Prompt → Ship

lesson.oneLiner: A Google Cloud engineer shipped a full app on stage with Claude in 26 minutes — outcome first, model second, no $500 course required.
beats: Frame: one engineer, one model, one clear goal — no team, no long setup.
Scope ruthlessly: name the app and cut everything that won’t fit a live clock.
Let Claude fill scaffold + UI + core logic while you steer the outcome.
Iterate in public: the demo has to work before the timer ends.
Same pattern as Dom’s desks: charge once → define the outcome → hand the middle to the tool.
lesson.takeaway: Under a minute: pick one tiny shippable app, set a hard timer, and make Claude the pair-programmer — not the boss.
